plugins.name: horizon-shield
plugins.description: Check Japanese construction and renovation estimates against the open JCCDB dataset with recomputable fair-price receipts, and find contractors that passed the independent fair-price check. No API key. Adds /audit, /red-flags, /verify.

plugins.name: mcp-conduct-register
plugins.description: See how an MCP server or AI agent behaved when it was measured, with a Bitcoin-anchored history you can recompute. Read-only. Adds /conduct, /nenrin.
